scripts.clean: pnpm run --parallel clean && pnpm exec del-cli "**/node_modules" "**/.turbo"
scripts.fix: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:app && pnpm run test:e2e:source-material
scripts.test:e2e:app: docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.0-noble && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter '@cup/e2e' test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:update: docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.0-noble && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter '@cup/e2e' test:e2e:update
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:fast && pnpm run validate:extended
scripts.validate:extended: pnpm run declutter && pnpm run brand-assets:check && pnpm run zizmor && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.validate:fast: pnpm run env:check && pnpm run submodule:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run docs:check && turbo run turbo:build turbo:lint turbo:test --output-logs=errors-only
scripts.validate:update-snapshots: pnpm run env:check && pnpm run submodule:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run docs:check && turbo run turbo:build turbo:lint && turbo run turbo:test --filter='!@cup/web-app' && pnpm --filter '@cup/web-app' test:components:update && pnpm run declutter && pnpm run brand-assets:check && pnpm run zizmor && pnpm run test:e2e:update && pnpm run test:e2e:source-material
